existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Except where fees are prescribed by statute or subsection (h) applies, each public agency may prescribe reasonable fees for providing access to or furnishing copies of public records, subject to enumerated limits.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Except as provided by subsection (h) or where fees for inspection or for copies of a public record are prescribed by statute, each public agency may prescribe reasonable fees for providing access to or furnishing copies of public records, subject to the following:
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Umbrella soft-standard ('reasonable'); the actual-cost ceiling is KS-0034. The city supplies the value under the reasonableness standard.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Copy fee capped at actual cost including staff time
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Fees for copies shall not exceed the actual cost of furnishing the requested records, including the cost of staff time required to make the information available.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency charges for copies of records
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: In the case of fees for copies of records, the fees shall not exceed the actual cost of furnishing the requested records, including the cost of staff time required to make the information available. Actual costs may include the cost to review and redact the requested records but shall not include incidental costs incurred by the public agency that are not attributable to furnishing the requested records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Unlike states that bar search/review labor, Kansas expressly permits charging staff time and review/redaction cost (KS-0035). Excludes non-attributable incidental costs.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Review and redaction costs chargeable; incidentals excluded
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Actual costs may include the cost to review and redact the requested records but shall not include incidental costs not attributable to furnishing the requested records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Actual costs may include the cost to review and redact the requested records but shall not include incidental costs incurred by the public agency that are not attributable to furnishing the requested records.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Computer-access fees limited to computer-service cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Fees for providing access to records maintained on computer facilities shall include only the cost of any computer services, including staff time required.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Access to records maintained on computer facilities
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: In the case of fees for providing access to records maintained on computer facilities, the fees shall include only the cost of any computer services, including staff time required.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Good-faith use of lowest-cost staff category
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If the agency incurs staff-time costs, it shall use in good faith the lowest-cost category of staff reasonably necessary to provide access or furnish copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency incurs staff-time cost to fulfill the request
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If the public agency incurs costs for staff time to provide access to or furnish copies of public records, the agency shall use in good faith the lowest-cost category of staff reasonably necessary to provide access to or furnish copies of public records.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Staff-time charges based on salary/wage, excluding benefits
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Charges for staff time shall be based on the employee's salary or hourly wage and shall not include the costs of employee benefits.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Charges for staff time shall be based on the employee's salary or hourly wage. Charges for staff time shall not include the costs of employee benefits.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Itemized statement of costs on request
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Upon request, the agency shall provide an itemized statement of costs charged to the requester, including the hourly rates for each employee involved and an itemized list of any other fees.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester asks for an itemized statement of costs
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Upon request, a public agency shall provide to the person requesting access to or copies of public records pursuant to this section an itemized statement of costs incurred by the public agency and charged to such requester. Such itemized statement shall include, but not be limited to, the hourly rates charged for each employee involved in making the requested records available and an itemized list of any other fees charged to provide access to or furnish copies of the requested records.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Cost of copying at other facilities and supervision fee
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If it is necessary to use other facilities for copying, the requester shall pay that cost; the agency may also charge the same supervision fee as for furnishing copies under subsection (c).
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Copying cannot practicably be done where records are kept, so other facilities are used
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If it is necessary to use other facilities for copying, the cost thereof shall be paid by the person desiring a copy of the records. In addition, the public agency may charge the same fee for the services rendered in supervising the copying as for furnishing copies under subsection (c) and may establish a reasonable schedule of times for making copies at other facilities.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: When staff time to respond will exceed five hours, or estimated actual staff-time cost exceeds $200, the agency shall make reasonable efforts to contact the requester and engage in interactive communication about mitigating costs; the requester is not obligated to mitigate.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Staff time to respond will exceed 5 hours OR estimated actual staff-time cost exceeds $200
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: When the staff time needed to respond to a records request will exceed five hours or the estimated actual cost for staff time needed to fill the request exceeds $200, the public agency shall make reasonable efforts to contact the requester and engage in interactive communication about mitigating costs to fill the request. The requester is not obligated to mitigate costs.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Added by L. 2025, ch. 89 (eff. 2025-07-01). Thresholds (5 hours / $200) are fixed statutory triggers. 'Reasonable efforts to contact' defined in (e)(3) as contacting via the means the requester provided.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Advance payment of fees may be required
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public agency may charge and require advance payment of a fee for providing access to or furnishing copies of public records, subject to K.S.A. 45-219.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency elects to charge a fee
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: A public agency may charge and require advance payment of a fee for providing access to or furnishing copies of public records, subject to K.S.A. 45-219.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Also stated in K.S.A. 45-219(a) for copies (see KS-0009).
